verdict.rationale: Stripe Issuing documents a dedicated testing flow: you can simulate test purchases before going live, and a testing guide covers testing your integration and simulating purchases. This means integrations can be exercised outside live production. missing for 10: explicit documentation of an isolated sandbox/test-mode environment with separate keys and data, detail on what can be simulated (authorizations, physical card shipping, funding), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
